chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), during his journeys, when he descended [from a height], he would glorify [Allah], and when he ascended, he would proclaim the Greatness [of Allah].
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say when ascending or descending during travel?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the Prophet’s (PBUH) mindfulness in linking physical terrain changes to spiritual elevation, a practice emphasized in Shia fiqh as part of travel etiquette (Adab al-Safar). It reflects the broader theological concept of recognizing Allah’s power in natural variations, reinforcing the believer's constant awareness (Taqwa) during journeys.
